convert_sew_checkpoint: convert a fairseq SEW checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model with CLI arguments
convert_config: convert a fairseq SEW model config to a HuggingFace SEWConfig object
recursively_load_weights: recursively load fairseq model weights into a HuggingFace SEW model structure
load_conv_layer: load convolutional layer weights from a fairseq checkpoint into a feature extractor
set_recursively: set tensor values recursively into nested HuggingFace model attributes by key path
